description: The project's error signatures in a period: failures grouped by fingerprint, with how often and how recently each occurred. Answers 'is this failure one instance of something that keeps happening' - a grouping no agent can compute from the repository alone. Counts finished runs, CI and local, by default (source=ci or source=local for one of them), a sharded run once, mass-failure runs included. Each test counts once across its Playwright projects: testCount and testNames (names without the project) are tests, projects names the projects the error hit. failedRunCount and flakyRunCount say how the runs ended: runs in which a test the error hit failed, and runs in which none failed and one passed only after a retry. failedCount and flakyCount count (run, test) pairs instead - a test once per run however many of its projects the error hit, and a run in which the error failed three tests counts three times there. Name an error to the user by displayTitle - the title Squally shows for it, the test's own assertion message when it wrote one - and its kind; title is an older spelling (kind, then locator).

days.description: The period, in days, ending now. Must not exceed the plan's retention (Standard 60, Pro 90 days); a longer period is refused with 400 invalid_period rather than answered with less data.

page.description: 1-based page number. A page past the end answers the last page.

source.description: Which runs count, by where they ran: all - every run (the default since 1.0.0-beta.18; ci before); ci - runs a shard reported a CI provider for; local - runs no shard did. The response's population names the one counted.

name: squally-list-errors

category.description: Why the error failed, by Squally's rule table over the example occurrence's message and its timeout flag - one of these five values; "Other" when no rule matched. The app shows them shortened (Assertion, Timeout, Element not found, Network, Other); this field keeps the full value. Documented as an enum on 2026-11-23; the values did not change.

displayTitle.description: The error's title as the app shows it - in the Error explorer, on the error's page, in the Overview and in a run's Errors tab: the test's own assertion message when it wrote one (the second argument of expect); otherwise the kind and what it was about ("Timeout · test limit", "Timeout · page.waitForURL"), or the kind alone when that is a locator ("Not visible" - the app sets the locator beside it); otherwise the message's first line. Never with a leading "Error:". Name an error to a person by this field. `title` keeps its own rule, kind then locator or message, unchanged (since 1.0.0-beta.19, additive).

failedCount.description: Of the (run, test) pairs the error hit - a test once across its projects - how many ended failed: the test's final attempt across all the run's shards failed in any project the error hit (since 1.0.0-beta.9; across projects since 1.0.0-beta.19, each project's variant its own pair before).

failedRunCount.description: Of runCount, the runs in which at least one test the error hit ended failed - each run counted once, however many of its tests failed (since 1.0.0-beta.18, additive).

firstSeen.description: First seen in what is still stored: the start of the earliest run of the population, as far back as the plan's retention keeps them, NOT bounded by the requested period. ISO-8601. (isNew, "absent in the period before", was removed in 1.0.0-beta.9: compare firstSeen with window.from.)

flakyCount.description: Of the same pairs, how many ended flaky: the final attempt passed after a retry in a project the error hit and failed in none. A pair whose final attempts skipped is neither (since 1.0.0-beta.9; across projects since 1.0.0-beta.19).

flakyRunCount.description: Of runCount, the runs in which no test the error hit ended failed and at least one ended flaky - passed after a retry. failedRunCount + flakyRunCount <= runCount (since 1.0.0-beta.18, additive).

kind.description: The kind of failure as the app names it - "Not visible", "Wrong text", "Timeout" - or null when Squally recognises none. The app shows it ahead of the file when displayTitle is the test's own message (since 1.0.0-beta.19, additive).

massFailureRunCount.description: Of runCount, the runs that were a mass failure as a whole (at least 20 tests, over 80% of them failed) - counted, and named here (since 1.0.0-beta.9).

projects.description: The Playwright projects those tests ran in, code-point order; empty when none ran under a named project (since 1.0.0-beta.19).

runCount.description: Runs of the population with at least one such attempt in the window - all shards of a run one run (since 1.0.0-beta.9; it counted every shard row).

testCount.description: The tests the error hit, each once across Playwright projects - a name without its project and a file (since 1.0.0-beta.19; each project's variant its own before).

testNames.description: Their names without the project, code-point order (since 1.0.0-beta.19; the stored names with it before).

population.description: Which runs every error figure counts: runs whose shards all finished, each counted once however many shards it ran in, placed in the period by the start of their first shard - runs that were a mass failure as a whole included (see massFailureRunCount). A run finishes when all its shards have, or - once it is overdue by the project's run timeout, counted from its latest shard's start - when every shard that started has completed, timed out or been stopped by the monthly result limit; such a run counts like a cancelled one, with the results its shards reported (since 1.0.0-beta.10; the monthly result limit since 1.0.0-beta.11). Runs still running are not counted. The prefix names the source parameter: ci_ - CI runs (a shard reported a CI provider); local_ - runs no shard reported a CI provider for; all_ - both, the default since 1.0.0-beta.18 (ci_ before it; since 1.0.0-beta.9).

unfingerprintedCount.description: Failed attempts in the window's runs of the population that carry no signature and are not grouped (the window only since 1.0.0-beta.9; it read the period before too). Expected 0.

unfinishedRuns.description: Runs of the source in the window that have not finished - a shard still running, or one timed out, stopped by the monthly result limit or never reported while the run is not yet overdue (an overdue one is finished and counted since 1.0.0-beta.10; a limit-stopped one since 1.0.0-beta.11). In no figure (since 1.0.0-beta.9).

title: List errors
